description: Trading and crafting talk from Living Server, rewritten.

lines.text: Crafting is slower than leveling and somehow I still love it.
94 percent again, the forge is teasing me.
I keep making things nobody needs, but my skill goes up, so.
Spellcrafting eats every copper I make.
Alchemy is just cooking with more smoke.
Fletchers never get enough credit.
Every crafter has a pile of failed attempts in the bank.
Crafting goes faster with good company in chat.
Buying materials in small batches is how you go broke slowly.
My bags are full of practice pieces nobody will buy.
The merchant pays almost nothing for practice pieces, it hurts.
Crafting is my way of relaxing after a bad night of dying.
It takes a silly amount of metal to make one good sword.
One day I will craft my whole suit myself. One day.
Overcharging is a gamble, and I always lose.
Dye sometimes costs more than the armor.
Crafters keep the whole realm dressed.
Tailors never get thanked until the leather runs out.
Anyone else find crafting oddly relaxing?
Which craft do you think is the most worth it?
Ugh, failed two in a row, the forge hates me.
Made a masterpiece, just saying.
I spend more time at the forge than in the field.
My favorite mobs are the ones that drop materials.
I look at every piece of armor and think how I would have made it better.
Crafting is where I unwind.
My skill went up a point and I celebrated like a ding.
Every crafter knows the exact number of bars in their bank.
Nothing quite like wearing armor you made yourself.
I spent my last gold on materials again, the skill better go up.
My best customers are the ones who say thanks.
WTB potions, anyone.
Anyone sell a better cloak for level {level}?
Making armor for the guild, materials cost a fortune.
Doing guild orders, materials are killing me.
Crafter here, making armor for guildmates.
The price of metal bars went up again.
Anyone need armor? My skill is finally high enough to be useful.
Crafting tip: buy materials in bulk, the merchants never run out.
Failed three times in a row, the forge hates me tonight.
My favorite sound is a successful craft.
There is no such thing as too many materials.
My bank is half materials, half regret.
Spellcrafting makes me nervous every single time.
Somebody please order something, I need the skill points.
Crafted a set for a friend, they wore it once and died, typical.
If it has a quality number, I have opinions about it.
The Exchange prices tonight are wild.
How much for it?
Check the Exchange first.
What is the price?
What stats?
Too rich for me.
What level is it?
Try the Exchange, it sells there.
Not for my class, sorry.
Seen those go cheap on the Exchange.
Is it still up?
Maybe, what are you asking?
I will pass, good luck selling.
Someone will want it, keep asking.
Nice, good luck with the sale.
That would make a nice twink item.
A crafter could beat that price.
Already have one, good luck though.
Good luck selling that, someone will want it.
Try the Exchange, prices are fair.
Nice stuff, good luck with it.
Might look later.
Selling {item} on the Exchange, fair price.
Just listed {item}, if anyone needs one.
{item} up on the Exchange, priced to move.
Anyone need {item}? Listed it on the Exchange.
Put {item} on the Exchange, make me an offer.
WTB a better weapon for my {class}, anything in my level range.
Anyone selling armor for a {level} {class}?
Looking for {item}, will pay decent coin.
Anyone have spare dye? Want my gear to match for once.
WTB potions, mine ran out at the worst time.
Anyone know a crafter who takes orders? Need a {level} suit.
Looking for a spellcrafter, want to fix my stats before 50.
Anyone have spare metal bars? Paying the merchant price.
Leveling my craft, every failure is a lesson and a lot of coin.
99 percent quality, close enough to perfect for me.
Armor for half the guild this week, everyone wants their own dye.
Crafting is relaxing until you count the coin.
Need cloth for a few orders, anyone selling?
My craft skill is finally useful, guildmates keep asking for stuff.
Anyone know the next good item to skill up on?
The forge is my second home at this point.
Legendary someday, if my wallet survives.
Sold a full suit today, crafting finally paid for itself.
Spellcrafting tonight, the guild's gear first.
If anyone wants a spellcrafted piece, send me your stats and slot.
Overcharged a gem and it blew up. There goes a week of coin.
Masterpiece weapons on request, prices are fair, I promise.
What is everyone's craft? Thinking about picking one up.
Crafters are the real heroes of the realm, and nobody says it.
Do not sell your drops to the merchant before asking a crafter.
